notes: The designer chose the band 2 to 3 hours (interview A3.1 b). The band rule of interview section 2 gives value 2.5 (the middle) and tolerance 0.2 (the half width 0.5 divided by 2.5).
The game has no reset layer, so the file has no reset_gap and no run_min (interview section 2, rule of run_min).
unlocks: the unlock gaps 5 and 10 minutes force 11 unlocks in the first hour and 5 in each later hour (interview A1.3 and A1.4). No source counts unlocks, so the group is unsupported.
